How to become a PhD student
We are looking for highly qualified candidates with high grades and a focused interest in research. Relevant scientific degrees may be within e.g. physics, chemistry, biology, or mathematics.
National as well as international candidates may apply for the programme. Read more about the application, admission and admission requirements
.
We suggest that you frequently check the vacant PhD positions on our main site. Find vacant PhD positions at DTU Physics
.
Grade translation: In some of our PhD job postings we ask you to translate your grades to the Danish grading system. Please use this excel spreadsheet for the grade conversion.
